name: 44721 · Canton, OH
findings: ZIP 44721 (Canton) has 69 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44721 (Canton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 44721 (Canton) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.
